Call Tertiary Lymphoid Structures (TLS)

call_tls.Rd

Clusters lymphoid (B and T) cells with DBSCAN to find candidate immune aggregates, assigns every cell within `eps` of a clustered lymphoid cell to that aggregate, and calls an aggregate a TLS when it contains enough co-localized B and T cells. Aggregates containing mature dendritic cells (e.g. LAMP3+/DC-LAMP+) are flagged as mature-like.

Usage

call_tls(
  seurat_obj,
  fov_name = "fov",
  celltype_col,
  b_types = c("B_Cells"),
  t_types = c("CD4+_T_Cells", "CD8+_T_Cells"),
  dc_types = c("LAMP3+_DCs", "IRF7+_DCs"),
  eps = 50,
  minPts = 20,
  min_B = 20,
  min_T = 20,
  min_frac_B = 0.05
)

Arguments

seurat_obj

Seurat object with spatial coordinates.

fov_name

Field of view/image name (default: "fov").

celltype_col

Metadata column with cell type labels.

b_types

Cell type labels counted as B cells.

t_types

Cell type labels counted as T cells.

dc_types

Cell type labels counted as mature dendritic cells.

eps

DBSCAN neighborhood radius in coordinate units (microns for Xenium). Also the maximum distance for assigning non-lymphoid cells to an aggregate.

minPts

DBSCAN minimum lymphoid cells to seed a cluster.

min_B

Minimum B cells for an aggregate to be called a TLS.

min_T

Minimum T cells for an aggregate to be called a TLS.

min_frac_B

Minimum fraction of B cells in the aggregate (excludes pure T cell infiltrates).

Value

Seurat object with `TLS_id` (aggregate ID for cells in called TLS, otherwise `NA`) and `in_TLS` metadata. The per-aggregate summary is stored in `seurat_obj@misc$tls[[fov_name]]`; retrieve it with [get_tls_summary()].

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
seurat_obj <- call_tls(seurat_obj, celltype_col = "first_type")
get_tls_summary(seurat_obj)
} # }
